archetype: Interactive Awwwards-style on black — 'Neon Markers' palette with 3D depth
status: ACTIVE (2026-10-04). Replaces both the warm/terracotta light theme and the rejected Swiss/high-contrast light redesign.

colors.note: Token names in index.css are kept from the original warm theme so markup is stable: cream = page bg, sand = surface, stage = image bg, clay = text, terra = primary accent, sage = secondary accent, mustard = tertiary accent.
colors.borders: rgba(255,255,255,0.10) — use border-white/10, never border-clay/10 semantics

depth_and_3d.NO BOXES: User explicitly rejected translucent boxes/frames around objects and the grain texture. Objects (3D model, product dolls, images) float in space: black-bg photo + radial mask-image fade + elliptical neon glow underneath + animate-float. No depth-card, no grain, no giant watermark text.
depth_and_3d.glow-terra / glow-sage: neon ring + glow for CTAs and highlighted elements
depth_and_3d.TiltCard: components/TiltCard.tsx — perspective 1200px mouse tilt with moving light sheen; wrap cards/images in it (max 6–10 deg)
depth_and_3d.FoxModel: components/FoxModel.tsx — REAL Melanie GLB (/models/melanie.glb, from user STL) in React Three Fiber with vertex painting (drag on model = marker stroke); Hero3D.tsx wraps it with a frameless acrylic-marker palette; IntroGate.tsx shows it on the landing gate
depth_and_3d.glows: large blurred radial blobs (bg-terra/20, bg-sage/15, blur-[120px]) behind hero/sections
depth_and_3d.images: all product/hero photography on pure black studio bg with magenta/cyan rim light (generated 2026-10-04)

copy_rules.painting_tool: ALWAYS 'טושים אקריליים' (acrylic markers). NEVER 'מכחולים' (brushes). Kit = white doll + 6 acrylic markers + illustrated guide.
copy_rules.language: Hebrew RTL, brand IMAGO in Latin
copy_rules.superhero: demo experience — Meshy not connected; do not promise production

interactions_kept_from_original: giant outlined IMAGO watermark with scroll parallax
ScrollPaintStory pinned scroll-paint of Melanie (dark bg #07070A → #1C0A16)
testing: All interactive elements have data-testid. Hero 3D: hero-3d-lab, marker-{id}, hero-paint-melanie, hero-paint-reset, hero-paint-progress.
